frases.texto: You've heard that daylight saving time was invented for farmers.
frases.estilo: Intrigue, like catching a friend repeating a fact.
Dry and punchy, with a half smile.

frases.texto: Germany was the first big country to try it, in nineteen sixteen, to save fuel during World War One.
The U.S. followed in nineteen eighteen, for the same war reason.
And farmers hated it. Cows don't read clocks, and the work followed the sun.
They pushed so hard that Congress repealed it in nineteen nineteen.
Heads up: it did come back later, and a federal law has set the dates since nineteen sixty-six.
This Sunday, November first, at two a.m., we fall back one hour.
Saturday night, fix the clocks your phone won't: the oven, the microwave, the car.
Send this to the friend whose microwave has been wrong since March.
